title: Node attempt workspace
description: Objective: implement node detail, attempt detail, plan, context, verification, review, and artifact inspection without transcript contamination. Deliverable: node/attempt modules in the standalone app. NOT in scope: editing evidence or exposing worker transcript in clean review. Hard dependency: Generated control-room client. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/nodes/** and apps/control-room/src/attempts/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: Current authority, input/result hashes, lease/epoch, context, receipts, findings, and recovery state are distinguishable.
Clean review excludes transcript/journal while attempt detail keeps operational history separate.
Missing evidence is UNKNOWN and never presented as success.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.
reopenReason: Governor promotion: sole stated dep (Generated control-room client, task-cc9a6953) is DONE, and the structural prerequisite I held it on last pass is now satisfied — apps/control-room exists as package @moe/control-room with src/kernel.tsx, src/fixtures.ts, src/main.tsx and a vitest target. Owns apps/control-room/src/nodes/** and attempts/** only; disjoint from the approvals and shell-frame siblings promoted alongside.

comments.author: architect-c4babdf9
comments.content:
SPIDR breakdown chosen after repo/spec audit: the original node/attempt workspace would be ~2k LOC and cannot satisfy the <=400/task, 1–3-file, or <=250-file rails.

Created five file-disjoint presentation slices, all accepting already-projected/preclassified daemon facts rather than inventing query-response schemas:
- task-a40fb298e38e484e939e83a06e80c290 — node authority/plan inspector
- task-c978268baa014ee88a12d45ad41b4421 — node input/result/context/recovery inspection
- task-c625fafc012c49339a07de2c35fb4237 — receipts/artifacts/findings/blockers
- task-65e010557f284f46838e68f9e591cb5a — attempt operational detail and collapsed narrative transcript
- task-bed245f5ec4c430fb472e07aeb3bc272 — clean-review firewall

All five are independent and own exactly one component plus one focused test. The generated client currently supplies envelope builders only, not authoritative query-response/view types, so no child may invent transport schemas, fetching, or authority normalization. The current ownership also excludes kernel.tsx/main.tsx/router wiring; these are intentionally unmounted modules.

After the five children land, unblock this parent and plan it only as final node/attempt composition and hardening in apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-attempt-workspace.tsx plus node-attempt-workspace.test.tsx. That final slice should compose the child modules, prove all DoD facts remain distinguishable, exercise a realistic missing-evidence UNKNOWN case, assert clean review has zero transcript/journal while attempt detail retains collapsed operational history, enforce every touched TS/TSX <=250, and own the exact full gate `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`. Do not edit root shell/router/docs under this task.
